scope: SQLite engine verification of an author-designed example, not a skill/LLM efficacy test

queries.not_in: SELECT id FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders) ORDER BY id
queries.not_exists: SELECT id FROM customers AS c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders AS o WHERE o.customer_id=c.id) ORDER BY id
queries.filtered_not_in: SELECT id FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY id
